newsitem.title: USA: CKS sees McKinney adding $0.10/shr a yr.
newsitem.headline: CKS sees McKinney adding $0.10/shr a yr.

text.p: CKS Group Inc on Monday said it expects its recent acquisition of advertising firm McKinney and Silver to boost the firm's 1997 earnings by about $0.10 cents a share.

"McKinney is expected to add about $0.10 (a share) in 1997, or about $0.025 in each quarter," to CKS's results, said Gina Bianchini, an official at CKS. She made the comments at the PaineWebber Internet Conference here.
CKS acquired the Raleigh, N.C.-based McKinney in February for $24 million in stock. Bianchini said McKinney earned $29 million in 1996.

The First Call consensus estimate for CKS's second quarter, which ends in May, is $0.18 a share. First Call's estimates the firm's 1997 earning at $0.76 per share. Last year, CKS reported earnings of $0.10 a share in the second quarter and $0.43 cents a share for the year.
CKS Group is a marketing communications firm that helps companies market their products and services in a variety of media including the internet.
